purpose: Schema-9 upgrade, restart safety, migration fingerprint, fixed Reviewer and Writer Context persistence, and preserved Researcher/Analyst handoff.

cases.input: A fresh schema-8 database with the accepted Researcher/Analyst state.
cases.expect: Exactly one schema-9 migration with the frozen identity and checksum plus stable Reviewer and Writer Context rows.

cases.input: The same database reopened after schema 9.
cases.expect: No duplicate migration or Context rows and no change to existing Researcher/Analyst records.

cases.input: The accepted Researcher/Analyst fixture after schema-9 Context persistence.
cases.expect: A schema-valid handoff with unchanged winning Researcher and Analyst identities and digest.

cases.input: A conflicting migration identity, checksum, or Context identity.
cases.expect: Bounded failure with no partially committed authority state.

workerRule: The implementation Worker may read this Oracle but must not modify it. Any mismatch is REPLAN_REQUIRED.
